## What's new in 2.0

### Top Gear 2 and Top Gear 3000
Both sequels now run in Top Gear PC, rewritten in C like the first game and checked frame by frame against the original. The launcher has a page for each game and finds your ROMs (and Top Gear 3000's `dsp4.bin`) when you drop them on its window.

Their extras, all off by default:
- **Top Gear 2:** widescreen, smooth motion, ghost car, auto-save (your passwords are kept), 2 players side by side, rumble, and keeping the music whole (in the original, sound effects take over parts of the music and leave gaps; this keeps all of it playing under them).
- **Top Gear 3000:** widescreen (roadside objects and cars fill the side areas too), smooth motion (the race updates every second frame; the game's own code can't go faster), ghost car and rumble. Its 1-player view is already full screen and the cartridge saves your game itself.

Each game keeps its own best races for the ghost car. High frame rate stays a Top Gear option: in the sequels smooth motion with VSync looks the same and keeps the timing right.
